requirements.description: The user explicitly wants the building to be close to public transport. The value is set at the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71).
A university student residence clearly needs convenient access to universities and schools. The value is set at the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14, rounded to 75).

The user requires energy class C or better, so classes A1 through A4, B and C are accepted. The other requirements (Turin location, at least 850 sqm, capacity for 60 people, proximity to public transport, CDP/PNRR funding) are not energy requirements and were not included.

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area, so this is a direct minimum surface filter. The 60-person capacity is not converted into an area threshold because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was provided. Energy class and public transport proximity are not reference columns and are ignored here. Turin is a geographic constraint handled by the Location Agent, not a cadastral comune_code.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on office properties (property_type 'Uffici e assimilabili', mapped from the requirement's tipologia since only property_type is filterable), surface_area >= 850, energy_class in A1-A4/B/C, mobility >= 71, education >= 75, and a 3.0 km haversine radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892). Results are ordered by distance to that point. The 60-occupant capacity was not translated because no matching column is listed in the requirements or the allowed filterable columns.
